name: import-offer-on-a-fresh-profile
description: A launch with no spaces.json and an Arc folder on disk opens Settings on the import pane, writes importPromptShown, and a relaunch does not offer again. Import from the offer opens a fresh spaces document, and the result line and the sidebar show the spaces. The fixture is ignored because spaces_absent points the spaces file at an empty folder.

actions.note: gate: only the offer path emits this line
the pane opened on import and asked for its preview

actions.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.import-run'); if (!b) { return 'no button'; } b.click(); return 'clicked'; })()

actions.note: evidence: the result line on a fresh profile
Work and Home, by their Arc emoji, reached the sidebar from the fresh document
long enough for the offer's 20 tries at 500ms to have run

assertions.desc: the offer opened the import pane with the Arc card

assertions.expected: "Added 3 spaces, 6 tabs, 2 favourites, 3 routing rules and 1 profile. 1 already in Atrium. 1 skipped."
assertions.desc: Default matched the fresh document's profile, Side Project was created, the bad regex was skipped

assertions.label: offered-once
assertions.desc: passes whether the count reads one log segment or both, and fails on a second offer
